question: A Florida policy has a scheduled location in flood zone AE. Is flood damage to the building covered, and what is required?

facts.fact: Flood is removed from MM-CP-0010 by exclusion EXCL-FLD (Water (flood, surface water, overflow)), which lives in MM-CP-1030 and is pulled in by Section B.1
MM-CP-E101 (Flood Coverage Endorsement - Scheduled Locations) deletes EXCL-FLD and restores Flood for COV-A, COV-B; sublimit 250,000, deductible 5% (minimum 25,000); approved in TX, FL

Rule R01 (scoped): PROHIBITION Claim pay_for_loss Peril:Flood WHEN Claim.onPolicy.hasForm = MM-CP-0010 SOURCE MM-CP-0010#SECTION-B/B.1 UNLESS Claim.onPolicy.hasEndorsement = MM-CP-E101 AND Claim.atLocation.scheduledUnder = MM-CP-E101 AND Claim.affectsCoverage IN (COV-A, COV-B) - narrowed/scoped by R02 (Layer 5 precedence)
facts.source: [MM-CP-0010 | SECTION B - EXCLUSIONS AND LIMITATIONS / B.1 | p.2]

facts.fact: Rule R02 (active): PERMISSION Claim pay_for_loss Peril:Flood WHEN Claim.causeOfLoss = Flood WHEN Claim.onPolicy.hasEndorsement = MM-CP-E101 REQUIRES Claim.atLocation.scheduledUnder = MM-CP-E101 REQUIRES Claim.affectsCoverage IN (COV-A, COV-B) SOURCE MM-CP-E-SERIES#1-MM-CP-E101/1.2
facts.source: [MM-CP-E-SERIES | 1. MM-CP-E101 - FLOOD COVERAGE ENDORSEMENT - SCHEDULED LOCATIONS (Ed. 06/2025) / 1.2 | p.1]

facts.fact: Rule R09 (active): OBLIGATION Location schedule_location Endorsement:MM-CP-E101 WHEN Location.inFloodZone IN (A, AE, V, VE) UNLESS Location.^hasLocation.floodAcknowledgmentSigned = true SOURCE MM-UW-CP-2025#SECTION-4/4.4
facts.source: [MM-UW-CP-2025 | SECTION 4 - REQUIRED ENDORSEMENTS AND FORMS / 4.4 | p.3]

chunks.text: [MM-CM-CP-2025 SECTION 2 - COVERAGE VERIFICATION 2.3 p.1] 2.3 If MM-CP-E101 is attached and the premises is a scheduled location, Flood damage to COV-A and COV-B is covered up to the Flood Sublimit of $250,000 subject to the 5% Flood Deductible; COV-D is not covered unless the Schedule shows a COV-D Flood Sublimit.

question: What must the insured do after a loss, and how quickly must a Florida claim be acknowledged?

facts.fact: MM-CM-CP-2025 1.1: 1.1 The insured is required by MM-CP-0010 Section E.3(b) to report loss within 72 hours of becoming aware of it; in Florida, MM-CP-FL-01 Section 5.3 extends this period to 14 days. Late notice must not be used to deny a ... (deadline: within 72 hours) EXCEPTION: unless the delay prejudiced our investigation.
facts.source: [MM-CM-CP-2025 | SECTION 1 - FIRST NOTICE OF LOSS (FNOL) / 1.1 | p.1]

facts.fact: MM-CM-CP-2025 1.2: 1.2 The adjuster must acknowledge receipt of every claim in writing within 14 calendar days in Florida and within 15 business days in Texas, per the applicable state claims-handling requirements referenced in Filings MM-... (deadline: within 14 calendar days)
facts.source: [MM-CM-CP-2025 | SECTION 1 - FIRST NOTICE OF LOSS (FNOL) / 1.2 | p.1]

facts.fact: MM-CM-CP-2025 3.2: 3.2 Initial reserves must be set within 5 business days of FNOL and reviewed every 30 days. (deadline: within 5 business days)

MM-CM-CP-2025 4.1: 4.1 Under MM-CP-0010 Section E.3(d) the insured must submit a signed, sworn proof of loss within 60 days of our request. The adjuster may extend this period in writing. (deadline: within 60 days)
facts.source: [MM-CM-CP-2025 | SECTION 4 - PROOF OF LOSS AND PAYMENT / 4.1 | p.3]

facts.fact: MM-CM-CP-2025 4.2: 4.2 Under Section E.4 we must state our coverage position within 30 days of receiving the proof of loss and pay undisputed amounts within 30 days. (deadline: within 30 days)
facts.source: [MM-CM-CP-2025 | SECTION 4 - PROOF OF LOSS AND PAYMENT / 4.2 | p.3]

facts.fact: MM-CM-CP-2025 5.2: 5.2 For fire losses at premises with MM-CP-E415, the adjuster must obtain evidence that the scheduled protective safeguards were operational, or that any impairment was reported to us within 48 hours. (deadline: within 48 hours)
facts.source: [MM-CM-CP-2025 | SECTION 5 - VACANCY AND PROTECTIVE SAFEGUARDS / 5.2 | p.3]

facts.fact: MM-CM-CP-2025 6.2: 6.2 Salvage must be offered for sale within 30 days of payment where the recovery is expected to exceed $2,500. (deadline: within 30 days)
